newsitem.title: USA: Pennsylvania April revenues 8.1 pct above forecast.
newsitem.headline: Pennsylvania April revenues 8.1 pct above forecast.

text.p: Pennsylvania collected $2.1 billion in tax revenues for April, $154.7 million or 8.1 percent above official estimates, the state's Department of Revenue said.
Year-to-date collections of $14.5 billion are $524 million, or 3.8 percent, above estimates.

Strong annual personal income tax payments helped to push revenues from taxes not withheld from paychecks well above estimate. Total non-withholding collections were $106.9 million, or 33.4 percent, above estimate for April and are above the year-to-date estimate by 18.9 percent.
Utility property tax collections for April fell short of estimates by $22.5 million.
